messages:
nora: tiny shoutout — samir turned up with a massive thermos of chai and a stack of paper cups. absolute hero move this morning. thanks!! :pray:
samir: happy to fuel the crew :) grabbed the recipe from my grandma, who insists on milk foam for authenticity :tea:
jess: OMG the foam was next level. also thanks for the little handwritten 'help yourself' sign, very charming :sparkles:
kai: also props to henry for bringing the oatmeal cookies — labeled 'contains nuts' and everything. responsible snacking! :cookie:
henry: we practiced our cookie labeling protocol. success. tiny victory for food safety :shield:
ava: posting a dramatic reenactment GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/coffee-handsome-3oriO0OEd9QIDdllqo
ora: that GIF is chef's kiss :chef_kiss: made me laugh out loud in the meeting :joy:
ops-bot: quick poll created: "Cookie/Chai rota" — react with 1 for 'I can bring next week' or 2 for 'Not this time'. Poll closes in 72h
samir: follow-up logistics note: if you're bringing something communal, please put a sticky note with your name + allergen info on the lid. saved a sandwich this morning from mystery sauce :grimacing:
jess: agreed. also leaving a box of spare zip bags in the pantry cupboard for leftovers — feel free to use
kai: big thanks to everyone who tidied up after the snack rush. the cleanup crew rules :raised_hands:
ava: can we add a tiny rule: 'no unlabelled Tupperware for more than 24h' — personal experience speaking :sweat_smile:
henry: signing up to bring chai again in two weeks unless someone else volunteers
nora: love this. small rituals like this make remote/hybrid weeks feel cozy. big kudos team :heart:
ops-bot: reaction summary — :heart: 6, :raised_hands: 3, :joy: 2
